title: A Comparison of Telemedicine Acceptance in the Follow-up Care of Outpatients Over Time
summary: The purpose of the survey is to determine how patients view telemedicine applications as part of follow-up care after outpatient procedures, and whether they have already used similar services.

interventions.name: An anonymous survey is being conducted among patients at Aachen University Hospital. All participants will complete the same questionnaire.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The survey is distributed to adult patients who have undergone outpatient surgery at Aachen University Hospital and have been in contact with the Department of Anesthesiology prior to discharge.
Exclusion criteria:
The individual has not reached the age of majority.
There is a significant language barrier.
There will be a subsequent inpatient admission.
